infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: This app uses the camera to take a photo when you return a rented bike.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This app accesses your photo library so you can upload a return photo if needed.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your camera to take a return photo.
plugins.photosPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your photos to upload a return photo.
